## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat: …`, `fix: …`, `feat!: …` for breaking changes). It becomes the squash commit and drives the release version.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests cover the change. Any new fixture is synthetic or fully sanitised (no names, emails, hostnames, client or story identifiers, or free text).
- [ ] README updated if behaviour, inputs or outputs changed.
